title: Hiram
dek: An Elder whose arguments expose the tension between financial survival, political continuity and local defense.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
Continuity and office

Hiram appears among Pristinia’s Elders. In the early assembly he opposes repeated selection, arguing that an Elder should be able to concentrate on the settlement instead of popularity. That is his argument about an institutional design, not a description of every later rule.

The debt crisis

He warns that Pristinia’s resources cannot meet its obligations to the Rahu, distinguishing recurring shortfalls from total debt. He presents default as a threat to war and trust, then turns to Ziegler’s proposed solution. Kaja’s resistance and Magda’s announced decision preserve the debate rather than making Hiram’s preferred answer inevitable.

Local defense

In a later public assembly Hiram reports roughly two dozen volunteers meeting at the Archery Range every two weeks, with basic equipment and mainly defensive capabilities. The report records local training at that moment; it is not a permanent troop count or a claim that he created the range.

Recorded scenes

  • Hiram seated among the Elders
  • His argument against repeated selection
  • Debt and the prospect of default
  • Turning to Ziegler’s proposal
  • Reporting the volunteers’ training
